verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a state business-filing service, which could offer batch filings, bulk record downloads or multi-entity updates, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any batch or bulk capability. The Gateway items mention only vague 'Filing Administrator' enhancements and single-profile updates, and both probes of the Secretary of State's own sites (ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov) returned 403 at robots.txt, so nothing further could be read.
